facts.text: The x-axis reports its physical position in centimetres
The x-axis constructs a linear-actuator protocol named XAxis on channel x
A physical position is converted from the sensor position with the slope and intercept of a linear calibration
Reading the physical position requests the Position channel and converts the last sensor position
move_by_physical_delta reads the current physical position, adds the delta and returns the final physical displacement
The feedback controller clamps its target position to the position limits Low and High
Actuator effort, roughly the signed motor duty cycle, must be between -255 and 255 inclusive
An actuator effort of 0 puts the motor in brake mode
A forwards actuator effort below the Low limit is set to 0 to brake the motor
The robot's Arduino exposes a USB serial command interface for positioning commands
